title: On the dependence of the zero-free region of a partition function on the external field
summary: Let $\{0, 1\}^n$ be the Boolean cube, endowed with the probability product measure, where ${\Bbb P}(1)=p$ and ${\Bbb P}(0)=q$ with $0 < p \leq q$ and $p+q=1$. For $i=1, \ldots, m$, let $φ_i: \{0, 1\}^n \longrightarrow {\Bbb C}$ be $L_i$-Lipschitz functions in the Hamming metric, such that each $φ_i$ depends on at most $r$ coordinates of $x \in \{0, 1\}^n$, where $rp \geq 12$. For $j=1, \ldots, n$, let $I_j $ be the set of indices $i$ such that $φ_i$ depends on the $j$-th coordinate.
